cart_stock_semantics: One depot 'carts' unit is one serviceable aggregate military transport cart team with its ordinary harness/draft allocation. It is not one individually simulated wagon or one extra human body.

principles.camp: The train persists the physical camp arrangement, baggage park, animal lines, kitchens, sanitation, medical area, pickets and temporary-depot custody refs without spawning new population.
principles.cargo_custody: Food, fodder, ammunition and engineering stores remain in the exact formation logistics ledgers that already own them. The train references custody and transports it; it does not duplicate cargo.
principles.cart_conservation: Creating or reinforcing a train transfers exact cart teams out of an accessible depot. Releasing them transfers the same surviving carts back. Damage changes serviceability; destruction is permanent loss.
principles.one_owner_per_army: A materially moving recursive army uses one exact aggregate train owner, never one file per wagon.
principles.standalone_formation: A strategically moving standalone formation materializes one exact formation-train owner with the same cart conservation, duty-allocation, damage, delay and camp rules; its own logistics ledger remains cargo authority.
